data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this stylish studio apartment in The Pinnacle, Dubai Hills Estate, offering modern comfort in one of Dubai’s most desirable communities.

This beautifully furnished unit features a bright open-plan layout, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a relaxing pool view. Fully furnished, contemporary finishes, and a fully equipped kitchen, it is ready for immediate move-in and ideal for anyone seeking a convenient, turnkey home.

Apartment Features:

Fully furnished
Pool view
Fully equipped kitchen
Floor-to-ceiling windows
Parking Space

Building & Community:

Located in The Pinnacle, Dubai Hills Estate
Swimming pool and gym
24/7 security
Peaceful, green surroundings
Close to Dubai Hills Park

Location Highlights:

Walking distance to Dubai Hills Park
5 minutes to Dubai Hills Mall
15 minutes to Mall of the Emirates
20 minutes to Downtown Dubai & Burj Khalifa
20 minutes to Dubai International Airport
A modern, fully furnished studio in a prime location, perfect for comfortable living in the heart of Dubai Hills Estate.
